scenarios.description: A worker pathfinds to a distant mineral node — the movement/order system must issue a valid move command and the engine must advance the unit toward the target without clipping or stalling.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Engine tests confirm units advance per tick; order tests confirm move commands are well-formed and dispatched; the worker reaches the target node within the expected tick budget.

scenarios.description: A soldier attacks an enemy base — combat resolution must apply damage, respect cooldown and range, and emit a combat event with correct source/target ownership.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Combat and combat-resolution tests pass confirming damage application, cooldown, and range checks; combat events carry correct source/target ownership.

scenarios.description: Resource gathering and spending loop — workers harvest, resources accumulate, and the engine spends them on build orders without leaking state across ticks.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Gas-loop tests confirm the resource gather/spend cycle is deterministic and leak-free; engine tests confirm the economy loop advances correctly per tick.

scenarios.description: Replay hash consistency — a game run from a fixed seed must produce a deterministic state hash at every checkpoint, and replaying the recorded command stream must reproduce the identical hash.
scenarios.pass_criteria: Replay v2 and hash tests pass (replay reproduces recorded hash at each tick); determinism smoke test confirms two runs from the same seed produce identical state; no non-deterministic RNG is introduced.
